description: This file contains the PHP class 'Layout' within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It handles CRUD operations for layout objects in the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin interface, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting layouts. The class interacts with models, loads language strings, manages URLs with query parameters, and prepares data for views related to layout management.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Controller class for managing layout configurations in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing existing layouts, creating new ones, editing, and deleting layouts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the layout controller that loads the layout management page, sets up breadcrumbs, handles sorting and pagination parameters, and prepares data for the layout view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list all layouts, with sorting and pagination, and returns the view with layout data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of layouts based on current sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters, and returns the view for layout listing.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Alias or specific method that loads the list of layouts and outputs the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Loads the form for creating or editing a layout, including setting the title, breadcrumbs, loading layout info if editing, and preparing the view data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a layout (not fully shown in chunk 1), processing submitted form data, validating, and updating or creating layout entries.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected layout entries with permission checks, updating the data store, and returning JSON response with success or error messages.
